title: Ether price again rejected at $2K: How low can ETH go in March?
summary: Ether needed to hold a key support recently established at $1,800, coinciding with the lower trend line of a classic chart pattern that warns of a drop below $1,500.

title: Aave Chan Initiative to exit Aave DAO after governance clash over funding
summary: The move follows a 52.58% Snapshot vote on a $42.5 million funding package for Aave Labs, now headed to the ARFC stage before any binding onchain decision.

title: Deloitte signs off on Anchorage reserve report for Tether’s USAT stablecoin
summary: Big Four firm Deloitte attested to $17.6 million in reserves backing USAt, Tether’s new US-regulated stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank.

title: Bybit claims new fraud system stopped $300M of risky withdrawals in Q4 2025
summary: Bybit says most of the $300 million “saved” came from users backing out after real-time warnings, highlighting how exchanges are shifting from recovery to preemptive fraud stops.

title: Japan PM Takaichi disavows ‘Sanae Token’ after memecoin hits $28M peak
summary: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi said she had no knowledge of the token, as Kyodo reported the FSA was considering whether unregistered operators were involved.

title: Stablecoins could weaken bank lending and monetary policy in Europe: ECB
summary: The European Central Bank warns in a new working paper that as stablecoin adoption grows, deposits may leave banks, affecting lending and monetary policy transmission.

title: Bitcoin price chart ‘death cross’ is back, reviving late-cycle fears
summary: BTC price has slid about 35% on average over a month after similar trend line crossovers, keeping downside risk in focus for traders.

title: Kalshi, Polymarket face trading halt in Nevada after court rulings
summary: The two separate rulings add new regulatory pressure as prediction markets also face scrutiny over information advantages and suspected insider activity tied to event-driven contracts.

title: Riot reports record $647M revenue in 2025 as other Bitcoin miners struggle
summary: Riot Platforms posted record 2025 revenue of $647 million, driven by $576 million in Bitcoin mining revenue, while holding 18,005 BTC worth $1.6 billion.

title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs see $458M in inflows as Mideast conflict widens
summary: US spot Bitcoin funds saw strong inflows and increasing volumes on Monday as institutional demand held up in spite of increasing Middle East tensions and broader market uncertainty.
